tests.title: Repo Valid method reports true only when both Owner and Name are non-empty

Valid() returns false if either Owner or Name is empty

assert Repo{Owner: "foo", Name: "bar"}.Valid() == true

tests.title: ParseRepo parses standard owner/repo and nested group/subgroup/project paths
given: repository path strings representing standard and nested group structures
tests.when: ParseRepo is called with valid slash-delimited repository path strings
then: the last path segment is assigned to Name
all preceding path segments joined by slash are assigned to Owner
the returned boolean is true
tests.pseudocode:
r1, ok1 := ParseRepo("octocat/Hello-World")
assert ok1 == true
assert r1.Owner == "octocat" && r1.Name == "Hello-World"

r2, ok2 := ParseRepo("gitlab-org/subgroup/project")
assert ok2 == true
assert r2.Owner == "gitlab-org/subgroup" && r2.Name == "project"

tests.title: ParseRepo rejects empty strings and inputs lacking slash-delimited segments

tests.when: ParseRepo is called with empty, single-word, or invalid strings

the boolean returned is false

tests.title: ParseRemote successfully parses HTTPS, SSH, and SCP-style git remote URLs
given: various valid remote URL strings across HTTPS, SSH, and SCP-style syntax for GitHub and GitLab
tests.when: ParseRemote is called with valid git remote URLs
then: ParseRemote returns true and populates Host, Owner (including nested groups), and Name without .git suffix
tests.pseudocode:
r1, ok1 := ParseRemote("https://github.com/octocat/Hello-World.git")
assert ok1 == true && r1.Host == "github.com" && r1.Owner == "octocat" && r1.Name == "Hello-World"

r2, ok2 := ParseRemote("git@gitlab.com:group/subgroup/repo.git")
assert ok2 == true && r2.Host == "gitlab.com" && r2.Owner == "group/subgroup" && r2.Name == "repo"

r3, ok3 := ParseRemote("ssh://git@github.com/org/repo.git")
assert ok3 == true && r3.Host == "github.com" && r3.Owner == "org" && r3.Name == "repo"

tests.title: ParseRemote rejects invalid remote URLs and unsupported formats
given: invalid, empty, or unsupported remote URL strings
tests.when: ParseRemote is called with invalid remote strings
then: the function returns a zero-value Repo struct
the boolean returned is false

tests.title: ParseIssueURL parses GitHub and GitLab web issue and PR/MR URLs into IssueRef
given: valid GitHub and GitLab web issue and pull/merge request URLs
tests.when: ParseIssueURL is called with web URLs
then: ParseIssueURL returns true and sets Repo, Number, and IsPullRequest accurately for issues and PRs/MRs
tests.pseudocode:
ref1, ok1 := ParseIssueURL("https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/123")
assert ok1 == true && ref1.Repo.Owner == "owner" && ref1.Number == 123 && ref1.IsPullRequest == false

ref2, ok2 := ParseIssueURL("https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/456")
assert ok2 == true && ref2.Repo.Owner == "owner" && ref2.Number == 456 && ref2.IsPullRequest == true

ref3, ok3 := ParseIssueURL("https://gitlab.com/group/sub/proj/-/issues/789")
assert ok3 == true && ref3.Repo.Owner == "group/sub" && ref3.Number == 789 && ref3.IsPullRequest == false

ref4, ok4 := ParseIssueURL("https://gitlab.com/group/sub/proj/-/merge_requests/101")
assert ok4 == true && ref4.Repo.Owner == "group/sub" && ref4.Number == 101 && ref4.IsPullRequest == true

tests.title: NewWithOptions resolves forge type from explicit BaseURL containing github or gitlab
given: Options with explicit BaseURL targeting GitHub and GitLab hosts
tests.when: NewWithOptions is called with explicit BaseURL
then: GitHub URL resolves to ForgeTypeGitHub
GitLab URL resolves to ForgeTypeGitLab
tests.pseudocode:
// Pre-adapter phase: detection succeeds, then unsupported forge error is returned indicating missing adapter
_, err1 := NewWithOptions(Options{BaseURL: "https://api.github.com"})
assert errors.Is(err1, ErrUnsupportedForge)
assert strings.Contains(err1.Error(), "github")

_, err2 := NewWithOptions(Options{BaseURL: "https://gitlab.example.com/api/v4"})
assert errors.Is(err2, ErrUnsupportedForge)
assert strings.Contains(err2.Error(), "gitlab")

tests.title: NewWithOptions detects forge type and endpoints from forge-specific environment variables
given: environment variables set for GitHub only, and alternatively GitLab only
tests.when: NewWithOptions is called with empty BaseURL and environment variables set
then: presence of GitHub tokens resolves to GitHub forge with default endpoint https://api.github.com
presence of GitLab tokens resolves to GitLab forge with default endpoint https://gitlab.com/api/v4
tests.pseudocode:
// GitHub only:
t.Setenv("GITHUB_TOKEN", "gh-tok")
t.Setenv("GITLAB_TOKEN", "")
_, err1 := NewWithOptions(Options{})
assert errors.Is(err1, ErrUnsupportedForge)
assert strings.Contains(err1.Error(), "github")

// GitLab only:
t.Setenv("GITHUB_TOKEN", "")
t.Setenv("GITLAB_TOKEN", "gl-tok")
_, err2 := NewWithOptions(Options{})
assert errors.Is(err2, ErrUnsupportedForge)
assert strings.Contains(err2.Error(), "gitlab")

tests.title: NewWithOptions falls back to local git origin remote when environment variables are inconclusive

tests.when: NewWithOptions is called without BaseURL and with inconclusive environment variables

tests.pseudocode:
dir := setupTempGitRepoWithOrigin("git@gitlab.com:team/project.git")
origDir, _ := os.Getwd()
os.Chdir(dir)
defer os.Chdir(origDir)

t.Setenv("GITHUB_TOKEN", "")
t.Setenv("GITLAB_TOKEN", "")

tests.pseudocode:

tests.title: Error classifiers correctly identify not-found, conflict, rate-limit, and no-token conditions
given: various wrapped errors and HTTPError instances
tests.when: calling IsNotFound, IsConflict, IsRateLimited, and IsNoToken helper functions
then: IsNotFound returns true for ErrNotFound or HTTP 404
IsConflict returns true for ErrConflict or HTTP 409
IsRateLimited returns true for ErrRateLimited, HTTP 429, or HTTP 403 with remaining 0
IsNoToken returns true for ErrNoToken
tests.pseudocode:
assert IsNotFound(ErrNotFound) == true
assert IsNotFound(&HTTPError{Status: 404}) == true
assert IsNotFound(errors.New("other")) == false

assert IsConflict(ErrConflict) == true
assert IsConflict(&HTTPError{Status: 409}) == true

assert IsRateLimited(ErrRateLimited) == true
assert IsRateLimited(&HTTPError{Status: 429}) == true
assert IsRateLimited(&HTTPError{Status: 403, RateLimitRemaining: "0"}) == true

assert IsNoToken(ErrNoToken) == true
assert IsNoToken(errors.New("other")) == false

tests.title: Shared transport bounds response body reads to a maximum of 8 MB
given: an HTTP response stream exceeding 8 MB in size
tests.when: reading a response body exceeding 8 MB using the shared transport helper
then: response body reads are capped at 8388608 bytes (8 MB)
tests.pseudocode:
largeBody := make([]byte, 10<<20) // 10 MB
r := io.LimitReader(bytes.NewReader(largeBody), 8<<20)
readBytes, err := io.ReadAll(r)
assert err == nil
assert len(readBytes) == 8388608

tests.title: NoOpClient pull request methods return explicit errors requiring an active forge client
given: an instantiated NoOpClient instance
tests.when: calling pull request methods on NoOpClient
then: every pull request method returns a non-nil error
each error contains 'pull request operations require an active forge client'
tests.pseudocode:
ctx := context.Background()
client := NewNoOp()
ref := IssueRef{Repo: Repo{Owner: "a", Name: "b"}, Number: 1, IsPullRequest: true}

_, err1 := client.CreatePullRequest(ctx, ref.Repo, CreatePullRequestRequest{})
assert err1 != nil && strings.Contains(err1.Error(), "pull request operations require an active forge client")

_, err2 := client.ReadPullRequest(ctx, ref)
assert err2 != nil && strings.Contains(err2.Error(), "pull request operations require an active forge client")

_, err3 := client.ReadChangedFiles(ctx, ref)
assert err3 != nil && strings.Contains(err3.Error(), "pull request operations require an active forge client")

_, err4 := client.GetPRState(ctx, ref)
assert err4 != nil && strings.Contains(err4.Error(), "pull request operations require an active forge client")

_, err5 := client.GetCIChecks(ctx, ref)
assert err5 != nil && strings.Contains(err5.Error(), "pull request operations require an active forge client")

_, err6 := client.GetPRReviews(ctx, ref)
assert err6 != nil && strings.Contains(err6.Error(), "pull request operations require an active forge client")

err7 := client.PostReviewComment(ctx, ref, "")
assert err7 != nil && strings.Contains(err7.Error(), "pull request operations require an active forge client")

_, err8 := client.MergePullRequest(ctx, ref, MergeOptions{})
assert err8 != nil && strings.Contains(err8.Error(), "pull request operations require an active forge client")

err9 := client.ClosePullRequest(ctx, ref)
assert err9 != nil && strings.Contains(err9.Error(), "pull request operations require an active forge client")
